answer: Sybil resistance requires each identity to bond collateral in an attributable escrow. If k coordinated identities equivocate on the same bridge, pairwise evidence makes penalties scale with k(k−1)/2, or O(k²), rather than as independent per-key fines. Detection also compounds asymmetric collateral depreciation, imposing an exponential multiplier on swarm-wide capital loss. Splitting stake across an island of keys cannot dilute liability, even when each key appears ivory-clean.
